explanations: Correct. Project knowledge is background for every chat in the project, so sharing the project shares everything uploaded to it with everyone who can open it.
A larger knowledge base is a performance and tidiness concern, not the serious exposure here.
Documents can be removed from project knowledge at any time; the exposure is the real problem.
Claude does not refuse to work in a project because a sensitive file has been uploaded to it.
